summary.goal: Pause execution at human gates, notify stakeholders, and handle approval/rejection decisions. Gates are explicit checkpoints where human oversight is required.

acceptance_criteria.description: Transition task to 'awaiting_approval' state when gate reached
Set run.has_pending_gate=true to pause new task scheduling
GET /gates/pending returns all pending gates across runs
POST /gates/:taskId/approve with optional comment resumes execution
POST /gates/:taskId/reject with reason fails the task and pauses run
SSE notification when gate is reached
Gate decision stored with approver identity and timestamp

observations: Gates are checkpoints, not tasks - no agent spawned
Human approval is blocking - no new tasks scheduled until resolved
Rejection may require plan revision via ChangeRequest to Planner
Gate ID is same as task_id (1:1 relationship)
patterns: Notification via SSE to Forge UI
Audit trail of approvals with identity

architect.gate_id: Same as task_id - gates are 1:1 with tasks that have gate config

steps.title: Create Gate entity and status types
steps.description: Define Gate entity for tracking approval workflow state

acceptance_criteria.description: GateSchema: { gate_id (same as task_id), task_id, status, approver_role?, decided_by?, decided_at?, comment?, created_at }

specification.pattern_description: Create with Zod schema following existing domain patterns
specification.notes: gate_id = task_id for simplicity, they are 1:1

steps.title: Verify gates table in storage
steps.description: Gates table schema defined in forge-storage, verify storage methods work

acceptance_criteria.description: Verify ForgeStorage.createGate() works with gate schema
Verify ForgeStorage.updateGate() updates status, decided_by, decided_at

specification.notes: Table schema defined in forge-storage fs-s2, methods in fs-s1

steps.title: Implement gate detection in task processing
steps.description: Detect gate steps and create gate instead of spawning agent

acceptance_criteria.description: When processing task from queue, check if forgeStep.gate exists
If gate: create Gate entity, set task status to 'awaiting_approval'
If no gate: proceed with normal agent spawn

steps.title: Implement scheduling pause on gate
steps.description: Pause task scheduling while gate is pending

acceptance_criteria.description: When gate reached, set run.has_pending_gate = true via storage.updateRun()
If has_pending_gate=true, skip enqueueing new tasks

architecture.pattern: Flag-based scheduling pause, not full run pause
architecture.integration: Uses Run.has_pending_gate field defined in forge-domain

acceptance_criteria.description: Updates task status to 'failed' with rejection reason
Run stays paused (has_pending_gate becomes moot since task failed)

architecture.post_rejection: User can cancel run or request plan revision via ChangeRequest
